title: A lens that translates
blurb: A circle over an article shows the same text in French, Spanish, German or Japanese, in simpler words, or as one-line summaries. The canvas draws a converted copy of the article inside the circle, lined up block by block, and the original still takes clicks.
question: Can a canvas draw a translated, simplified or summarised copy of an element inside a lens, lined up with the original, and which on-device language APIs can fill the copy?
result: A second drawable child holds the copy. Drawing it once per block, clipped and moved to the original block, keeps the two lined up. The APIs were not usable in the test browser; recorded text stands in.
